nodes.description: Public balance mapping of the UniswapExchange honeypot token; mutated directly without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested allowance mapping of UniswapExchange; consumed by transferFrom and written by approve.
Total supply of the UniswapExchange token, set once in the constructor with an unchecked multiplication.
Privileged owner address assigned from msg.sender in the constructor; gates init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Whitelisted trading address set by setTradeAddress; bypasses the sale checks inside ensure.
Per-address whitelist mapping that allows transfers to skip the condition() restriction in ensure.
Per-address counter of sales, incremented in transferFrom and enforced against _saleNum inside condition.
Minimum transfer amount configured by init; enforced in condition.
Maximum transfer amount configured by init; enforced in condition.
Maximum number of sales per address configured by init and checked in condition.
Private balance mapping of the reference ERC20 implementation, updated only through SafeMath-backed helpers.
Private nested allowance mapping of the reference ERC20 implementation.
Private total supply of the reference ERC20 implementation, adjusted in _mint and _burn.
Public payable transfer entry point that simply forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Whitelist gate that bypasses restrictions for owner, tradeAddress, UNI addresses and canSale entries, otherwise delegates to condition.
Public payable token transfer that adjusts allowance and balance mappings with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure before moving funds.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without validation.
Sale restriction logic comparing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale against the recipient counter and transfer value.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall payload supplied by the caller, giving full control of contract storage.
Owner-only configuration of sale limits, performing unchecked multiplications by 10**decimals.
Owner-only batch airdrop that subtracts total from the owner balance with unchecked arithmetic and adds value to each recipient.
Owner-only setter that assigns the privileged tradeAddress used to bypass ensure.
Pure helper that computes the Uniswap V2 pair address from a hard-coded init code hash.
Deployer constructor that sets metadata, computes totalSupply with an unchecked multiplication, assigns owner and grants unlimited UNI allowance.
Low-level call wrapper that invokes an arbitrary token payload and decodes the optional boolean return value.
Assembly helper reading extcodehash to determine whether an address is a contract.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, ownership assignment and transfer authorization.
Arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address, allowing overwrite of all contract storage including owner.
Low-level call to an arbitrary token address inside callOptionalReturn.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom, open to underflow.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom, open to overflow.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend, open to underflow and overflow of the multiplication.
Unchecked multiplications token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) when initializing sale limits.
Unchecked multiplication _supply*(10**decimals) when minting the total supply in the constructor.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the implicit source of the transfer forwarded by transfer().
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from to decide whether allowance must be spent.
approve records the allowance under the caller's own address.
delegate is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner), making caller identity the access-control gate.
init is restricted to the owner via msg.sender comparison.
batchSend is restricted to the owner via msg.sender comparison.
setTradeAddress is restricted to the owner via msg.sender comparison.
The constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, defining the privileged account.
Destination address parameter is forwarded to transferFrom.
Source address parameter drives allowance and balance updates in transferFrom.
Destination address parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
Amount parameter is subtracted from sender and added to recipient in transferFrom.
Source address parameter is checked against the owner, tradeAddress, UNI and canSale whitelists.
Amount parameter is forwarded from ensure into condition.
Source address parameter indexes the _onSaleNum mapping in condition.
Amount parameter is bounded by _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
Target address parameter becomes the delegatecall destination.
Calldata parameter becomes the delegatecall payload executing in the contract's storage context.
saleNum parameter is written into the _saleNum restriction counter.
token parameter is multiplied unchecked by 10**decimals to derive _minSale.
maxToken parameter is multiplied unchecked by 10**decimals to derive _maxSale.
Recipient array parameter determines how many balances are credited in batchSend.
Per-recipient value parameter multiplies the array length to compute the deducted total.
Address parameter is stored in tradeAddress, which bypasses ensure's restrictions.
Spender parameter is used as the key for the granted allowance.
Locally computed pair address is compared with _from to whitelist the transfer inside ensure.
Locally computed total is compared with the owner balance before the unchecked deduction.
Loop-local recipient is credited the per-user value in batchSend.
transfer delegates all authorization to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
transferFrom calls ensure, whose whitelist logic decides whether the transfer proceeds.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the expected Uniswap pair address.
ensure falls back to condition when the sender is not whitelisted.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall payload, the contract's storage-takeover backdoor.
callOptionalReturn verifies the token is a contract before invoking it.
callOptionalReturn performs a low-level call to the token with caller-supplied calldata.
transferFrom performs an unchecked subtraction on the sender balance.
transferFrom performs an unchecked addition on the recipient balance.
batchSend performs an unchecked subtraction of the multiplied total from the owner balance.
init performs unchecked multiplications for the sale limits.
The constructor performs an unchecked multiplication for the total supply.
Unchecked subtraction mutates the public balance mapping of the sender.
Unchecked addition mutates the public balance mapping of the recipient.
Unchecked deduction from the owner balance in batchSend.
Unchecked multiplication result is stored as the minimum sale limit.
Unchecked multiplication result is stored as the maximum sale limit.
Unchecked multiplication result becomes the minted total supply.
ensure reads the owner address to decide whether to bypass transfer restrictions.
ensure reads tradeAddress as a whitelist bypass condition.
ensure reads canSale[_from] as a whitelist bypass condition, a hidden backdoor.
condition compares the number of prior sales against _saleNum.
condition reads the per-address sale counter to enforce the sale quota.
condition enforces the minimum sale amount.
condition enforces the maximum sale amount.
transferFrom reads and decrements the spender allowance.
transferFrom increments the per-sender sale counter _onSaleNum.

normalization_plan.reason: The destination parameter only feeds the transfer entry point and holds no independent state.
The source address parameter is a transient argument of transferFrom.
The destination address parameter is a transient argument of transferFrom.
The amount parameter is a transient argument of transferFrom.
The source address parameter only feeds the ensure whitelist check.
The amount parameter only feeds the ensure check chain.
The source address parameter only indexes _onSaleNum inside condition.
The amount parameter is only compared with the sale limits inside condition.
The target address parameter is only consumed by the delegate delegatecall.
The calldata parameter is only consumed by the delegate delegatecall.
The saleNum parameter is only written to _saleNum by init.
The token parameter is only used by init to derive _minSale.
The maxToken parameter is only used by init to derive _maxSale.
The recipient array parameter is only iterated by batchSend.
The value parameter is only used by batchSend for balance credits.
The address parameter is only stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowance key in approve.
The _UNI local variable is only a comparison value inside ensure.
The total local variable is only a transient sum inside batchSend.
The loop-local recipient is only a transient alias inside batchSend.
